name: Kamdhenu Ventures Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1995, Kamdhenu Ventures Ltd 
manufactures and sells wide range of paints[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile
It is among the top paint companies in India selling under the "Kamdhenu" brand, offering 40+ SKUs across 10+ product categories.  [1]

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 3.02% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 189 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -8.41%
